I also asked ChatGPT to see if they had any other ideas of good tests that could be run. 

me: "What would be the best type of tests to run if you want to find the selectivity of Universities admissions compared to one another in Rstudio?" 

Response: "If your goal is to determine whether some universities are more selective in admissions than others, I would recommend using a combination of descriptive statistics, ANOVA, and post-hoc comparisons in RStudio.
The best statistical test depends on what you want to prove, but ANOVA would be a good starting point if you're comparing several universities." 

Basically another alternative would be ANOVA, which would help compare selectivity amungst universities and amungst multiple years. This is the code they suggested I use: 

anova_model <- aov(Acceptance_Rate ~ University, data = admissions)

summary(anova_model)
